title: Solar PV Controller (Three-Phase)
text: 太阳能光伏 (PV) 跟网型 (GF) 控制器，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；{AC filter inductance (H)} 指定交流滤波器电感 3e-3、{System frequency (Hz)} 指定系统频率、{Inverter current limit (pu)} 指定逆变器电流限值、{Base impedance on AC side (Ohm)} 指定交流侧基准阻抗、{Base power on AC side (V*A)} 指定交流侧基准功率 6e5、{DC bus base voltage (V)} 指定直流母线基准电压、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Algorithm} 指定 MPPT 算法 Perturb、{Initial voltage for MPPT (V)} 指定 MPPT 的初始电压、{Voltage step of MPPT (V)} 指定 MPPT 的电压步长、{Settling time of MPPT (s)} 指定 MPPT 的稳定时间 5e-4、{Proportional gain} 指定比例增益、{Integral gain} 指定积分增益、{Initial phase angle (deg)} 指定初始相位角、{Derivative gain} 指定微分增益、{D-axis proportional gain} 指定 D 轴比例增益、{D-axis integral gain} 指定 D 轴积分增益、{D-axis derivative gain} 指定 D 轴微分增益、{Q-axis proportional gain} 指定 Q 轴比例增益、{Q-axis integral gain} 指定 Q 轴积分增益、{Q-axis derivative gain} 指定 Q 轴微分增益，按实例取值。

params.name: AC filter inductance (H)
params.values: 交流滤波器电感 3e-3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: System frequency (Hz)
params.values: 系统频率 60 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Inverter current limit (pu)
params.values: 逆变器电流限值 1.2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Base impedance on AC side (Ohm)
params.values: 交流侧基准阻抗 0.34 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Base power on AC side (V*A)
params.values: 交流侧基准功率 6e5 (default) | scalar

params.name: DC bus base voltage (V)
params.values: 直流母线基准电压 1000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | nonnegative scalar or -1

params.name: Algorithm
params.values: MPPT 算法 Perturb and observe (P&O) (default) | Incremental conductance (INC)

params.name: Initial voltage for MPPT (V)
params.values: MPPT 的初始电压 2000 (default) | scalar

params.name: Voltage step of MPPT (V)
params.values: MPPT 的电压步长 3 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Settling time of MPPT (s)
params.values: MPPT 的稳定时间 5e-4 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: 比例增益 200 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: 积分增益 2000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial phase angle (deg)
params.values: 初始相位角 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Derivative gain
params.values: 微分增益 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: D-axis proportional gain
params.values: D 轴比例增益 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: D-axis integral gain
params.values: D 轴积分增益 250 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: D-axis derivative gain
params.values: D 轴微分增益 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Q-axis proportional gain
params.values: Q 轴比例增益 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Q-axis integral gain
params.values: Q 轴积分增益 250 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Q-axis derivative gain
params.values: Q 轴微分增益 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar
